content_units: Toronto–Lisbon Best Flight Pick
For your family of   2 adults + 1 child  , the best overall choice is   Option 3: Airline Z at CAD 3,050 total  .

It stays within your   CAD 3,200 budget  , includes   one checked bag per person   (which covers your adult bag requirement), avoids   overnight layovers  , and has the   shortest total travel time   by a clear margin.

Why Airline Z Wins
-   Best time efficiency:   It has the shortest itinerary both ways, with   11h 5m outbound   and   13h 40m return  .
-   No overnight layover issue:   Unlike Airline Q, it does not violate your layover preference.
-   Baggage is stronger than required:   You asked for   one checked bag included per adult  ; Airline Z gives   one per person  , which is even better for a family.
-   Within budget:   At   CAD 3,050  , it remains under your   CAD 3,200 cap  .
-   Family comfort advantage:   Fewer stops and shorter travel time matter a lot with an   8-year-old  , reducing airport stress, transfer risk, and fatigue.
Best Alternative if You Want to Save More
Option 1:   Airline X     Lower price with solid timing and bags included     CAD 2,780
- Good backup if saving about   CAD 270   matters more than minimizing travel time.
- Still meets your main constraints:   bags included  ,   under 18 hours each way  , and   no overnight layover mentioned  .
- Trade-off: one extra stop each way and longer total travel time than Airline Z.
Booking Context
I treated the listed fares as the   total trip price for all 3 travelers  , since you gave a total budget and option totals in the same format.
